product_base_description: Merge pull request #139 — R-LIVE V2 multi-asset collector and staging config contract
note: docs_pr_head_sha must be updated to the final pushed HEAD SHA before sending to reviewer. final_live_main_sha must be confirmed after docs PR merge.
key_capabilities_post_pr139: R-LIVE V2 registry-driven 8-asset surface (AAPL, NVDA, AMZN, GOOGL, TSLA, AVGO, NFLX, AMD)
/radar redirects to /radar/r-live (R-LIVE is default Radar domain)
300-second TWAP freshness gate; STALE != UNAVAILABLE != empty
B2.3 concurrent duplicate delivery fix (PR #135): lock-safe, exactly one event
R-LIVE multi-asset collector (PR #139): no-arg collects all approved assets; serial iteration; STALE/UNAVAILABLE per-asset are not process failures
Staging collector config contract (PR #139): ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL + RADAR_BNB_INTELLIGENCE_DB_PATH; staging/production ledgers must be separate

operational_config_requirements.ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL: Required for both web current-read and the collector. Never committed to Git. Missing → fails closed.
operational_config_requirements.RADAR_BNB_INTELLIGENCE_DB_PATH: Shared durable B1.3 history ledger. Web and collector must use the identical path. Staging and production must be different files.
operational_config_requirements.FINCO_RUN_CERT_SIGNING_KEY: Required for Signed Run Certificate issuance. Ed25519 seed, base64. Missing → SigningKeyUnavailable.
operational_config_requirements.FINCO_SESSION_TOKEN: Required for MCP V1. Server-configured signed session token.
